Players Committee card image of [[Point Man (V)]] (original printing), game text: “USED: Move a trooper as a 'react' to a battle where you have a leader. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. LOST: During a battle at a site, cancel Keep Your Eyes Open.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/pointman.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
